cases.candidate_question: May the same inequality |∫f|≤∫|f| be used when a>b?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. For f=1 and a>b, the left side is a-b>0 but the oriented integral of |f| is b-a<0.

cases.candidate_question: Does a bound |f(a)|,|f(b)|≤c at the endpoints suffice for |∫f|≤c|b-a|?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. On any a<b, f(x)=(x-a)(b-x) vanishes at the endpoints, so c=0 satisfies the endpoint bound, but its integral is (b-a)^3/6>0.

cases.candidate_question: Can continuity be dropped if a nonnegative integrable f is positive at one point?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. The indicator of a singleton inside any nondegenerate interval is nonnegative and positive at that point but has integral zero.

cases.candidate_question: Does a continuous function with zero integral vanish everywhere even without nonnegativity?

cases.candidate_question: Can the nonnegative-weight assumption be removed from the weighted mean-value formula?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. On [-r,r] with r>0 choose f(x)=g(x)=x. The weight integral is zero, but ∫f*g=2r³/3>0, so no c can satisfy the formula.

cases.candidate_question: Does oddness and the total integral value zero prove that f is integrable?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. The total reciprocal f(x)=1/x is odd but is not Lebesgue integrable on any [-r,r], r>0. Its totalized interval-integral value is zero.

cases.candidate_question: Does ∫[-a,a]f=2∫[0,a]f hold for continuous odd f as well?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. Take f(x)=x and any a≠0. The symmetric integral is zero whereas twice the half integral is a²>0.

cases.candidate_question: Can equality of integrals over translated intervals be inferred from f(a)=f(b) alone?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. On [0,1] and [1,2], f(x)=x(x-1) has f(0)=f(1)=0, but the length-one integrals are -1/6 and 5/6. Endpoint equality does not give periodicity.

cases.candidate_question: Can the factor 1/c in the oriented affine-substitution formula be replaced by 1/|c|?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. For any c<0 and f=1 on [0,1], the left integral is 1 while (1/|c|)∫[d,c+d]1=c/|c|=-1.

cases.candidate_question: Does integrability of |f| alone imply integrability of every real f without a measurability assumption?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. Choose a non-Lebesgue-measurable subset A of a finite interval and let f be 1 on A and -1 off A. Then |f|=1 is integrable, while f is not almost-everywhere strongly measurable and hence not integrable.

cases.candidate_question: Is a product of two interval-integrable functions always interval-integrable?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. On [0,1], f(x)=g(x)=1/√x for x>0, extended by zero at 0, are integrable, but fg=1/x is not. Continuity of one multiplier on the compact interval supplies the missing bound.

cases.candidate_question: Is the integral unchanged by reversing endpoints?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. For f=1 and a<b, ∫[a,b]f=b-a and ∫[b,a]f=a-b; reversal changes sign.

cases.candidate_question: Does totalized integral subtraction hold with no integrability hypotheses?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. On [0,1], let q(x)=1/x away from 0, f=q, g=q-1. Both f and g are nonintegrable, so their total integrals are zero, whereas f-g=1 has integral 1.

cases.candidate_question: Is d/dx ∫[x,b]f equal to +f(x)?
cases.mathematical_reason: No. For constant f=c≠0, the integral is c(b-x) and its derivative is -c.

cases.candidate_question: Can the velocity of the lower endpoint be omitted in differentiating ∫[g(x),h(x)]f?

cases.candidate_question: Can closed-interval continuity be dropped when interior derivatives and their integrability hold?

cases.candidate_question: Does a sign-changing substitution derivative require replacing h by |h| in the oriented substitution formula?

cases.candidate_question: Can u≠0 be omitted from the reciprocal inverse derivative rule?

cases.candidate_question: Can strict positivity of the derivative be replaced by nonnegativity while retaining strict monotonicity?

cases.candidate_question: Does strict increase of f force its derivative to be strictly positive at every point?

cases.candidate_question: Can differentiability be dropped when the total derivative is nondecreasing?

cases.candidate_question: Does nondecrease, instead of strict increase, of the derivative imply strict convexity?

cases.candidate_question: Does every monotone function g have the intermediate value property enjoyed by derivatives?
